arithmetic: Q(sqrt5); every identity and rank below is exact

band.definition: loads f(p) = v_p . c, c in C^3; operator O on loads acts as V^T O V / (4 (phi + 2))

residual_groups.frame: the cubic frame whose axes are the coordinate axes of the raw port frame

table.group: Klein group of the frame (three half-turns)
table.eigenvalue_pattern: free: three independent eigenvalues, eigenvectors fixed (real basis)

table.group: third of a turn alone (in the frame stabilizer)
table.eigenvalue_pattern: free with fixed eigenvectors (one axial, two circular); the real symmetric members have two equal and one different

table.group: the tick's group (quaternion group, acting through the Klein group)
table.eigenvalue_pattern: free: three independent eigenvalues, eigenvectors fixed (real basis)
free: one eigenvector fixed, the other two in a free 2 x 2 block

table.group: fifth of a turn about a port
table.available_in: space (a) only (not in a frame stabilizer)
table.eigenvalue_pattern: free with fixed eigenvectors (one axial, two circular); the real symmetric members have two equal and one different

Klein group.general_form: diag(m1, m2, m3) in the frame axes
Klein group.eigenvalues: m1, m2, m3 (three free real numbers)

third of a turn.matrix_of_the_third_turn_in_the_frame_ax: the cyclic permutation P of the three axes (x -> y -> z -> x), trace 0, P^3 = 1
third of a turn.general_form: C = a 1 + b P + conj(b) P^2 (a real, b complex): 3 real parameters; the real symmetric members have b real
third of a turn.eigenvalues: a + 2 |b| cos(delta + 2 pi k / 3), k = 0, 1, 2, b = |b| exp(i delta) (triple-angle identity)
third of a turn.eigenvectors: the axis of the turn (1,1,1)/sqrt3 and the two circular states about it; independent of a, b
third of a turn.trace_identities: sum = 3 a, sum of squares = 3 a^2 + 6 |b|^2, so sum of squares / (sum)^2 = 1/3 + (2/3) |b|^2 / a^2
third of a turn.real_members: b real: eigenvalues a + 2 b, a - b, a - b (two equal and one different)
third of a turn.frame_independent_form: C = a 1 + b R + conj(b) R^-1 with R the third-turn on the band; any orthonormal triple that R permutes cyclically gives the same operator

one half-turn (about frame axis 1).general_form: [[m1, 0, 0], [0, x, z], [0, conj(z), y]]: 5 real parameters (4 when real)
one half-turn (about frame axis 1).eigenvalues: three free; eigenvector e_1 fixed; one free angle (and one phase) in the plane of e_2, e_3

fifth of a turn about a port.general_form: x n n^T + y (1 - n n^T) + k i [n]_x (n the unit port axis): 3 real parameters; real members have k = 0
fifth of a turn about a port.eigenvalues: x on the axial state, y + k and y - k on the two circular states

tick_group.image_in_the_rotations: the Klein group of the frame (each lift u_i covers the half-turn about axis i; -1 acts as the identity on the band)

fixing_a_frame_does_not_split_the_band.statement: the stabilizer of a cubic frame (order 12) still acts irreducibly on the band: every Hermitian operator invariant under it is a multiple of the identity
fixing_a_frame_does_not_split_the_band.what_splits: giving up the third-turn (Klein group remains: diag(m1, m2, m3)) or giving up the half-turns (third-turn remains: circulant)
